title: gitlab/job-log-timestamps cites the runner source that maps FF_TIMESTAMPS to UseTimestamps
goal: The fact in kb/public/gitlab/job-log-timestamps.md that the build takes the timestamp option from UseTimestamps cites, beside its current sources, the runner source file that maps the UseTimestamps feature flag to FF_TIMESTAMPS (helpers/featureflags/flags.go at the pinned runner commit), with its source row; found by the SP-caqrexqw review of ST-zqxgo47z (e0b8a53fa).
